name: dev-mentor
description: Learn to build features in your codebase, one focused step at a time.

interface.longDescription: Ten engineering mentoring workflows for finding where to start, tracing runtime behaviour, planning features, checking manual edits, understanding colleagues' PRs, and explaining completed work. Mentor can watch PR comments and CI when the host provides monitoring tools. Lessons use one focused card at a time. Teaching uses the current assistant and project tools; the three-model debate requires access to three distinct models.
defaultPrompt: Use mentor: help me find where to start in this codebase.
Help me build this feature one small step at a time. I'll write the code.
Walk me through this completed change and help me explain it to a colleague.
